newsitem.title: USA: Haggar restructures, consolidates TX plants.
newsitem.headline: Haggar restructures, consolidates TX plants.

text.p: Haggar Clothing Co said Monday that it will restructure its worldwide manufacturing capacity to save $12 million to $14 million a year in manufacturing costs.
The company said it expects to take a fourth quarter pretax charge of $14 million or about $1.07 per share for the restructuring, which it said should begin in calendar 1997.
Haggar said the restructuring includes the consolidation of its three Texas sewing plants into one facility but it did not give further details about personnel and plants to be affected.
It said however that it is working to optimize remployment and retraining opportunities for its employees.

"We are committed to being a strong Texas employer and will continue to maintain cutting, manufacturing and distribution operations, as well as our corporate headquarters in Texas," the company stated in a release.
The company said it will release fourth quarter results November 6.
